note: Walkable routes in the Golden Valley box, as polylines rather than texels, so a path can be named, lit, chosen and walked. Points are local metres (x east, z south, origin at the box centre) and carry no height: the map drapes them on the same height field the terrain is built from. `named` routes come from OSM route relations and are the ones offered as destinations; `strand` routes are the rest of the network, chained through junctions, drawn as context.
